title: MERO research architecture
key_message: MERO v0.1 connects excitation, observation, identifiability, and estimator qualification. Electrochemical interpretation is post-v0.1.

title: Controlled excitation matrix
key_message: The controlled core is a three-band by two-amplitude matrix with IDC fixed at 0.3C.

title: Measured response summary
key_message: Similar local electrical response can coexist with substantially different downstream CV memory. For F08, transfer differs by less than one percent while CV-shape RMSE differs by more than threefold.

title: Identifiability selectivity
key_message: Within frozen-model replay, F03 favors the slow branch, F06 is intermediate, and F08 shifts information toward the fast branch. Higher amplitude strengthens the signal without materially changing branch-selectivity ratios.

title: Evidence-to-decision map
key_message: Current evidence supports different roles for F03, F06, and F08. Direct released estimator evidence exists only for the gated F08 R0 context.

title: Evidence boundaries and roadmap
key_message: The major open gaps are physical causality, independent replication, cross-cell transfer, cross-temperature transfer, matched relaxation, and independent estimator validation.
